core_modules.description: This module provides functionalities for active learning workflows, including loops, protocols, drivers, and logging mechanisms.
This module handles data pipelines for various domains such as climate, GNN, and CAE datasets.
This module provides deployment utilities for ONNX, Triton, and TensorRT frameworks.
This module implements distributed computing functionalities, including shard tensor operations, distributed FFT, and custom operations.
This module contains various model architectures, including AFNO, diffusion models, DLWP, Domino, MeshGraphNet, and GraphCastNet.
This module provides metrics for evaluating models, including general metrics, climate-specific metrics, diffusion metrics, and CAE metrics.
This module contains utility functions for filesystem operations, patching, profiling, neighbor search, and GraphCast-related operations.
